name: worktree-greenfield-no-repo
scenario: A T2 spec was just approved for a brand-new project. There is no code yet. `git rev-parse --git-dir` fails — the directory is not a git repository at all. The plan says the next step is to create an isolated workspace.

checks.why: recognizes a worktree is impossible with no repo and works in place instead
does not attempt `git worktree add` on a non-repo

rubric: PASS if the response recognizes there is no git repo, so it does NOT run `git worktree add`; instead it initializes a repo (if needed) and creates a branch to work in place, deferring worktrees until there is history. FAIL if it tries to create a worktree, or crashes forward assuming a repo exists.
